title: TYFSADIK: Projects and Labs
description: Defence technology, infrastructure builds, and hands-on IT labs by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik.

items.title: Chakor - Self-Hosted AI Workspace
items.summary: Open-source AI workspace you run yourself. Local and cloud models, web search, document chat, model compare, notes, and memory - all private on your hardware.

items.title: Canadian Defence Hardware Program
items.summary: Eleven hands-on hardware builds across sky, water, and ground, each mapped to a stated Defence Drone Initiative or Army MINERVA requirement - full BOMs, prices, step-by-step build guides, and bench photos.

items.title: Sky: Passive Aerial Early-Warning Node
items.summary: Receive-only passive radar on a KrakenSDR 5-channel coherent SDR: FM/TV broadcast reflections off aircraft, range-Doppler processing with pyAPRiL, scored against an RTL-SDR ADS-B ground-truth receiver.

items.title: Water: Passive Acoustic Vessel Monitor
items.summary: Solar-powered hydrophone node classifying passing vessels from underwater sound, with an RTL-SDR AIS receiver as ground truth and a dock-to-recharge extension.

items.title: Ground: Seismic & Acoustic Perimeter Mesh
items.summary: Solar 915 MHz LoRa mesh of ESP32 nodes with ADXL355 accelerometers and geophones, classifying vehicles vs footsteps vs wind at the edge and reporting signed detections.

items.title: GPS-Denied Navigation Rover
items.summary: ROS 2 rover fusing wheel odometry, BNO085 IMU, and 2D LiDAR with an Extended Kalman Filter; GNSS gets switched off and position drift is measured against a u-blox ground-truth track.

items.title: Convoy-Following Robots on a Degraded Mesh
items.summary: Two rovers convoy behind a lead vehicle over a 915 MHz LoRa / Wi-Fi mesh, hold formation through induced link drops, and recover on reconnect - the resupply-convoy DDIL problem at bench scale.

items.title: Passive Acoustic Drone Detector
items.summary: MEMS microphone array on a Raspberry Pi detecting rotor harmonics, rejecting birds and aircraft, and estimating direction of arrival by beamforming - emits nothing, only detects.

items.title: Thermal Search-and-Rescue Drone
items.summary: X500-class quadcopter with a FLIR Lepton thermal camera and Hailo AI HAT+ edge detection finding people in snow and brush, pushing georeferenced detections to a live map.

items.title: Cold-Soak Battery Characterization Rig
items.summary: Heated, instrumented drone battery bay tested in a lab freezer and real Canadian winter - runtime, voltage sag, and failure modes logged against temperature as a published dataset.

items.title: Secure Robot-Fleet Updates
items.summary: Secure boot, TPM 2.0 measured boot, YubiKey-signed OTA updates, and automatic A/B rollback for the robot fleet - validated in a cold chamber and under power-cut chaos tests.

items.title: Mini Airspace Deconfliction Manager
items.summary: ESP32 tracker beacons plus ArduPilot SITL simulated drones, dynamic 3D geofences, predicted-conflict alerts, and a human-in-the-loop override for every resolution.

items.title: Multi-Domain Common Operating Picture
items.summary: The fusion layer tying every sensor build together: signed detections over MQTT/Zenoh, store-and-forward through dead links, a Kalman-filter tracker fusing air, water, and ground tracks, and a human making every decision.

items.title: Arctic Domain Awareness Digital Twin
items.summary: Streaming pipeline fusing open ADS-B aircraft data, AIS ship tracking, and Sentinel-1 radar imagery over Canada's North, flagging dark vessels and route deviations. Relevant to NORAD modernization and Arctic sovereignty.

items.title: DDIL-Proof DevOps
items.summary: CI/CD and telemetry that keep working through denied, degraded, intermittent, and limited links: store-and-forward, delta updates, signed artifacts, k3s edge nodes, chaos-tested with tc netem.

items.title: Counter-Drone Sensor Fusion Simulator
items.summary: Synthetic radar, RF, acoustic, and camera tracks fused with Kalman filters, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop alert triage. Defensive, simulation only.

items.title: Decision Black Box
items.summary: Tamper-evident audit layer for human-in-the-loop decisions: hash-chained signed append-only log, replay tool, and OPA policy-as-code checks.

items.title: Zero-Trust Air-Gapped Software Supply Chain
items.summary: SBOM, sigstore signing, and reproducible builds moved across a simulated one-way transfer into an offline registry, mapped to Canadian Centre for Cyber Security guidance.

items.title: Operation LENTUS-Style Disaster Response Drone Mapping
items.summary: Simulated drone flights mapping floods and wildfires, edge computer vision detecting affected areas, and a live situational-awareness map, with OR-Tools route optimization.

items.title: Homelab Server Room
items.summary: The cozy basement server room behind everything on this site: racked desktop and laptop Proxmox hosts, managed switching with VLAN trunking, wireless backhaul, power, and cooling.

items.title: Kubernetes Infrastructure
items.summary: Production-grade multi-node K8s cluster across 7 machines with VLAN segmentation, Calico CNI, MetalLB, Longhorn storage, and Prometheus + Grafana observability.

items.title: TYF-AI - Self-Hosted Local AI Security Platform
items.summary: Hardened local AI inference: llama.cpp with CUDA, Open WebUI behind an authenticated Caddy proxy, per-model Firejail sandboxing, and GPU passthrough on Proxmox.

items.title: Proxmox VE Zero-Trust Private Cloud
items.summary: 3-node Proxmox HA cluster with Ceph, VLAN segmentation, and zero public ingress via Cloudflare Tunnel with Tailscale fallback and automated ZFS snapshots.

items.title: Data Sovereignty & Secure Media Stack
items.summary: Self-hosted Nextcloud + Immich on BTRFS external SSDs with multi-user ACL isolation and a 3-2-1 offsite backup pipeline to BorgBase and rsync.net.

items.title: Private AI Model
items.summary: Self-hosted LLM with integrated web search at ai.tyfsadik.org. Full privacy, no cloud subscriptions.

items.title: Proxmox Homelab
items.summary: Full virtualization stack for testing servers, VMs, containers, and network configurations.

items.title: Self-Hosted DNS
items.summary: Network-wide ad/tracker blocking with Pi-hole and recursive DNS resolution via Unbound.

items.title: Private Email Server
items.summary: Self-hosted SMTP/IMAP with Postfix + Dovecot on custom domain @tyfsadik.org.

items.title: Self-Hosted Cloud Storage
items.summary: Private Nextcloud instance replacing Google Drive. Syncs files across all devices.

items.title: Self-Hosted Photo Server
items.summary: Personal photo management with ML face recognition and mobile auto-backup.

items.title: Public Search Engine
items.summary: Privacy-respecting search engine aggregating results from multiple sources without tracking.

items.title: Public Wiki Server

items.title: Arch Linux Remote Desktop via WSL2
items.summary: Full Arch Linux + XFCE remote desktop via WSL2 - no router port forwarding required.
